reviews.text: Traditional old-school masonry is alive and well with this contractor. Needed to get my front brick steps replaced after 60 years of wear and tear. Found Sam at Right Rate, LLC and did an outstanding job recreating my steps and matching both the brick and mortar lines perfectly. Sooo happy that used this contractor. Now I have a mason for future work!!!! He is outstanding and will definitely continue to use.

I needed a quick sidewalk repair and Sam immediately responded, providing a reasonable quote. Sam handled the permits and went to work replacing slabs and lifting the ones not in need of replacing. Working through inclement weather to complete the job before a freeze arrived I was impressed with the excellent outcome especially the detail of returning everything back to normal. I would definitely use Sam and his Rite Rate Construction for future needs.
